title: Acid-Base Titration
description: A focused endpoint-and-molarity exercise using acetic acid and NaOH. Students accept qualitative indicator evidence, immerse a prepared pH probe, record the simulator-predicted accepted-endpoint pH, and calculate analyte molarity. The dedicated Acid-Base Titration Curves route remains the complete Investigation 14 workflow.
learningGoals: Assemble a burette, use a filling funnel for conditioning and filling, then remove it to the workbench before reading its level.
Take burette readings off the instrument and record them as separate steps.
Calculate acid molarity from the volume delivered between two recorded readings.
Distinguish the ideal equivalence prediction from the pH predicted at the actually accepted endpoint.
safetyNotes: Wear goggles and gloves when handling acid, base, and indicator.
Keep the burette clamped upright and clean spills immediately.
Neutralize and dispose of titration waste according to local guidance.
